name: frotak
description: Atalhos do repositorio. Cada app tem o proprio package.json: frotak-central (Master) e frotak-tms (cliente).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frotak-central install && npm --prefix frotak-tms install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:central && npm run build:tms
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix frotak-central run lint && npm --prefix frotak-tms run lint
